summary: Hand-authored `task attach <task_id> <file>...` (validates every file first, one multipart upload per file, --dry-run preview, uploaded/failed result with non-zero exit on failure) and `task attachments <task_id>` (attachment rows with size and total/resolved/open comment counts), registered under the generated `task` command.
reason: Agents need to put local files onto tasks and see which attachments still carry unresolved comments; the generated surface could do neither. Both take --custom-task-ids/--team-id like `task get`.
validated_outcome: Live read of a task with a commented PDF returned one row per attachment with open_comments = total - resolved; `task attach --dry-run` previews URL, MIME type and size without sending.
